Instruction fuzz harness setup and execution with captured account and return-data effects.

# Purpose
This file builds and runs a fuzz test instruction context for the Solana runtime executor. The [`fd_runtime_fuzz_instr_ctx_create`](<#fd_runtime_fuzz_instr_ctx_create>) function prepares a full `fd_exec_instr_ctx_t` from a test input by creating temporary transaction and program cache state, loading accounts, restoring bank and sysvar state, setting the blockhash queue, and building the instruction account list. It also handles special cases such as adding the program account when it is not already present, marking writable accounts as mutable, and loading executable accounts for the BPF loader and upgradeable loader paths.

The file also defines the execution wrapper [`fd_solfuzz_instr_run`](<#fd_solfuzz_instr_run>), which calls `fd_execute_instr` and then collects the execution result into a fuzz output structure. It records the error code, remaining compute units, custom error data when allowed, modified account state, and return data. The helper [`fd_runtime_fuzz_instr_ctx_destroy`](<#fd_runtime_fuzz_instr_ctx_destroy>) clears the temporary account database and program cache after each run. Together, these functions provide the test harness used to execute one instruction under controlled runtime state and capture its effects for fuzzing.
